effect_alarm_desc: The ship's alarm is blaring — the noise is disorienting and makes actions harder. Check the terminal and disable the alarm to restore normal conditions.
effect_exhausted_desc: Completely drained of energy. Your health is now deteriorating.
effect_hungry_desc: Your food supplies are depleted. Stamina costs are drastically increased.
effect_life_support_failure_desc: Reactor fuel depleted. Life support systems are running on reserve — oxygen levels are dropping.
effect_oxygen_depleted_desc: No breathable air remains. Your health is rapidly deteriorating.
effect_thirsty_desc: You have no drinking water left. Stamina costs are severely increased.
effect_waiting_ping_desc: A ping has been sent into the surroundings. A response could arrive at any moment.
effect_waiting_ping_targeted_desc: A targeted ping to Gamma Site has been sent. Response should arrive shortly.
res_food_desc: Personal rations carried while exploring. Depletion causes Hunger penalties.
res_health_desc: Your physical condition. Passively regenerates over time.
res_oxygen_desc: Personal oxygen supply from the flight uniform. Protects you from the effects of depleted ship oxygen.
res_stamina_desc: Your endurance. Passively regenerates over time.
res_water_desc: Personal water carried while exploring. Depletion causes Thirst penalties.
skill_engineering_t1_desc: Basic knowledge of ship systems gained from studying technical manuals.
skill_engineering_t2_desc: Advanced knowledge gained through practical repairs — enables more complex system modifications.
skill_mechanics_t1_desc: You understand basic off-road vehicle drive systems. You can diagnose common faults and assess the condition of engine components.
item_canteen_use_desc: Drink up to 10 water from the canteen.
item_canteen_desc: A durable canteen, currently empty. Can hold up to 50 units of water.
